name: Running man

phases.name: left knee
phases.cue: Drive your left knee up, right arm forward

phases.name: left back
phases.cue: Step your left foot back, left arm forward

phases.name: left in
phases.cue: Bring your left foot back under you

phases.name: right knee
phases.cue: Drive your right knee up, left arm forward

phases.name: right back
phases.cue: Step your right foot back, right arm forward

phases.name: right in
phases.cue: Bring your right foot back under you

formTips: Swing your arms opposite to your legs, like a sprinter
Drive the knee up to about hip height
Tap the back foot down on its toes
Keep your chest up and core braced
commonMistakes: Hunching over as the knee comes up
Swinging the arm on the same side as the knee
Stamping the back foot down flat
